recall.minute: LLM limits: cut-off, no real-time or private knowledge, hallucination, long-context degradation, privacy/black box, no continual learning; retraining or PEFT too heavy per change. RAG: semantic search (embed query and chunks, cosine) → top chunks → augmented prompt → grounded answer (attendance 70% example); retrieve well × answer well. Top-K vs threshold (0.94, 0.88, 0.81 both pick 3; mediocre scores expose the difference); too many = noise/budget, too few = missing info; re-rank near-ties (0.990 vs 0.991). Budget: 10,000 − (300 + 200) = 9,500; 8,192 − (300 + 220) = 7,672 → ⌊7,672/512⌋ = 14; compaction at ~80–90%. Chunking: overlap (ABCDEF / EFGHIJ), stride = size − overlap; 18,200/(600 − 120) → ⌈37.9⌉ = 38. Precision/recall vs golden set: 2/5 = 0.4 and 2/2 = 1.0; 10/1000 = 0.01; 13/20 = 0.65. Latency: 2,500 − (150 + 420 + 1,600) = 330 ms → 300 ms re-ranker fits, 400 doesn't. Graph RAG: identify entities, traverse 1–2 hops; use when the connection is the answer (Rahul → NLP ← Dr. Vidhi; blast radius), not for single-entity lookups; vector vs KG table. Synergy: KG-enhanced LLMs (Obama → Honolulu → USA), LLM-augmented KGs (EGF upregulates miR-31), synergised. Multimodal RAG (charts, photos; shared embeddings or narrate to text). Agentic RAG: plan → retrieve → reason loop (nuclear vs solar); agents fail politely, so evaluate every step.
